value.rationale: Natural global degree conditioning of a canonical negatively dependent random-tree model can reverse the sign of disjoint-edge dependence while preserving incident-pair nonpositive correlation. The exact all-degree all-pair finite formula, maximal \(1/4\) counterexample on the minimal host \(K_{2,3}\), and a no-leaf-endpoints positive family at every \(t\ge4\) are structural and motivated, not a routine isolated coefficient or table.
